translations.web: He wanted to fill his belly with the husks that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.
translations.bsb: He longed to fill his belly with the pods the pigs were eating, but no one would give him a thing.
translations.kjv: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
